decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A001_Location Plan; A002_Block Plan. Received 01/02/2018 A200_Ground Floor Plans_REV 01; A201_First Floor Plans_REV 01; A202_Attic Plans_REV 01; A203_Roof Plans_REV 01; A241_Rear Elevations_REV 01; A240_Front Elevations_REV 01; A270_Section A-A_REV 01. Received 16/03/2018 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with one rear dormer and three front roof dormers,increase of ridge roof height to the house, changes to fenestration at the front and rear elevation and alterations to the front entrance.
